en.name: Match Cut Transition
en.title: Match Cut Transition: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: Six app scenes cut on one fixed anchor while an orange avatar stays at the same spot. Make it with Claude Code or Codex from the free recipe.
howto: Fix one anchor at (780, 450) and scale each scene's own avatar to exactly 112 px centered there. Six scenes (team chat, calendar invite, issue tracker, pull request, video call, product) cut at 2.0, 3.0, 3.75, 4.4 and 5.05 s. Cuts are hard: opacity flips in one frame with no cross-fade, so the face stays still while everything around it changes.

Place each in-scene change on one frame after the cut: reaction 1.15 s, status 3.3 s, mic 4.6 s, Approve to Approved 6.85 s. Scenes drift 3% (scene 6: 5%) with ease none, popovers use expo.out over 0.4 s and cards use 0.5 s with a 0.16 s stagger. On the end card the avatar moves 40 px right and 90 px down, scales to 1.45x and swaps initials for a gem glyph.

Press the copy button on the recipe page and paste it into Claude Code or Codex, or run npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent renders an MP4 with HyperFrames, or ports the GSAP timeline to your site with your own scenes.
faq: A match cut joins two shots through a matching shape, position or movement, so the viewer's eye stays on the same place while the subject changes. Classic examples cut from one object to a visually similar one; in product films the shared element is often a fixed UI anchor.
How do I make a match cut for a product video?

Fix the shared element at one position and size across every scene, then cut so the new element lands exactly where the old one was. Put any change inside the scene on a separate frame after the cut, as the recipe does.
Is the Match Cut Transition recipe free to use?

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

zh.name: 匹配剪辑转场
zh.title: 匹配剪辑转场：示例与制作配方
zh.description: 六个应用场景围绕同一个锚点硬切，橙色头像始终停在原位。用免费配方，让 Claude Code 或 Codex 做出这段匹配剪辑转场。
howto: 在 (780, 450) 设一个固定锚点，把每个场景自己的头像缩放到恰好 112px 并居中放在那里。六个场景（团队聊天、日历邀请、问题追踪、代码审查、视频通话、产品）在 2.0、3.0、3.75、4.4、5.05 秒硬切。切换是一帧内翻转 opacity，没有交叉淡化，所以头像不动，周围的一切在变。
场景内的变化都放在切换之后的一帧：反应 1.15 秒，状态 3.3 秒，麦克风 4.6 秒，Approve 变 Approved 6.85 秒。每个场景缓慢漂移 3%（第 6 个场景 5%），缓动为 none；弹出层用 expo.out 0.4 秒，卡片用 0.5 秒并错开 0.16 秒。结尾画面里头像右移 40px、下移 90px，放大到 1.45 倍，首字母换成宝石图形。
在配方页点复制按钮，粘贴给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以运行 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装技能。智能体会用 HyperFrames 渲染 MP4，或者把 GSAP 时间线移植到你的网站，场景换成你自己的。
faq: 匹配剪辑通过相近的形状、位置或运动把两个镜头接在一起，让观众的视线停在同一个位置，而画面里的主体已经换了。经典例子是从一个物体切到外形相近的另一个物体；产品片里，共用的元素常常是固定在同一处的界面锚点。
产品视频怎样做匹配剪辑？
让共用的元素在每个场景里保持同样的位置和大小，切换时新元素正好落在旧元素的位置上。场景内部的变化像配方一样放在切换后的另一帧。
匹配剪辑转场配方可以免费使用吗？
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
